title: Rolling roadmap, floating Road Ahead & Admin log filters
changes: The Journey ahead list now looks 10 lessons ahead (up from 8) and shows a mapped milestone, activity, or topic-change badge where one genuinely applies.
Road Ahead is now a floating bubble in the bottom-left corner of the Journey screen, plus a floating Dashboard button top-left — both overlays only, the Journey screen itself is unchanged.
Immersive activities (Picture Matching, Listening, Karuta, Kanji Gate) are only mapped to a future lesson when that lesson's actual words have the audio/art/kanji data the activity needs.
Admin Centre logs gained a category filter: All, Offline, Roadmap, Lesson mapping, Activities, Journey, System.
Roadmap and activity-mapping decisions are now logged to Admin Centre for diagnostics.
